title: "delaying load events mode" phrasing is slightly broken
body:
https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#the-iframe-element:delaying-load-events-mode says:

> When the iframe's browsing context's active document is not ready for post-load tasks, and when anything in the iframe is delaying the load event of the iframe's browsing context's active document, and when the iframe's browsing context is in the delaying load events mode, the iframe must delay the load event of its document.

I'm not really clear on the use of "and" here.  Is this trying to say that _all_ the conditions need to be true to delay the load event of the iframe's document?  Because that doesn't make any sense.

  <!DOCTYPE html>
  <iframe src="http://example.com"></iframe>

During the load of example.com, the active document in the iframe's browsing context is the initial about:blank, which per https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsers.html#windows%3Aready-for-post-load-tasks is "ready for post-load tasks".  So taking the  "and" in that quote at face value as a logical conjunction, this HTML should not block the parent page's load event.  That's not the desired behavior, and not what browsers implement in this case.

I think what's desired here is probably that if _any_ of the listed conditions is true then the load event on the parent document should be delayed, and that the "and" in the quote above shoul be "or".  But I'm not 100% sure about that for the "anything in the iframe is delaying the load event of the iframe's browsing context's active document".  If that's true but the document is "ready for post-load tasks" (i.e. its onload has fired or is about to fire, but something else started more network activity somewhere under it), should the parent's load event be blocked?  That part is not clear to me; I haven't checked what browsers do.

There's similar phrasing at https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/iframe-embed-object.html#the-object-element:delaying-load-events-mode and https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/iframe-embed-object.html#the-embed-element:delaying-load-events-mode
